specificTenantIdentity: unproved; no tenant identifier is bound by this static contract
runtimePrerequisites: Fresh native cached authenticated Entra session and strict exact-target preflight; preserve selected account/directory without switching. No tenant identity is proved, no billing configuration control may be activated, no GET/PUT request may be authored. A future HTTP404, including a verified empty response, does not establish its entitlement/configuration/role cause.
executionBindingScope: Canonical full executable recipe, including every action/scope/required flag, target/network scope, policy, budgets/capture flags/timeouts and all other recipe fields. This records a fresh approval commitment, not a new capture or rewrite of historical execution.
